title: Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces Billing Memo: The Total Electric Upgrade Difference
content:
**Rule.** A Total Electric Hospital Bed (E0265) is billed to coverage as the semi-electric class. The patient owes, on each paid month, the difference between the E0265 fee and the E0260 fee for that month, each multiplied by the coverage class's allowed percentage of the fee schedule, divided by 100 and rounded to the cent half up — and only where the coverage class's upgrade billing is permitted. The difference is charged only when the upgrade notice is signed: the upgrade notice on file of the bed record is signed. Without it the difference is written off under the coverage charter.

This memo concerns the Hospital Beds & Support Surfaces Total Electric class. The fee for each month is the class's published rental fee for that month number (months 1 through 3, or month 4 on); the allowed percentage and whether upgrade billing is permitted belong to the patient's coverage class in the Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility records.

### Defining the difference

For one paid month, the upgrade difference is:

1. the E0265 fee for that month, multiplied by the allowed percentage and divided by 100, rounded to the cent half up;
2. less the E0260 fee for that month, multiplied by the same percentage and divided by 100, rounded to the cent half up.

Each fee is rounded before the one is taken from the other.

### Conditions for charging it

| Upgrade notice on file of the bed record is signed | Coverage class permits upgrade billing | The difference for the paid month |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Charged to the patient |
| No | — | Not charged; written off under the coverage charter |
| — | No | Not owed by the patient |

The signed notice is read from the bed record in the system, before the month's difference is charged.

### Worked figures (hypothetical coverage percentages)

Fees used: E0265 at $195.80 for months 1 through 3 and $146.85 from month 4 on; E0260 at $148.64 and $111.48.

| Hypothetical case | E0265 part, rounded | E0260 part, rounded | Difference owed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Month 2, coverage allowing 96 percent | 187.968 gives $187.97 | 142.6944 gives $142.69 | $45.28 |
| Month 6, coverage allowing 96 percent | 140.976 gives $140.98 | 107.0208 gives $107.02 | $33.96 |
| Month 2, coverage allowing 100 percent | $195.80 | $148.64 | $47.16 |
| Month 6, coverage allowing 100 percent | $146.85 | $111.48 | $35.37 |

In each row the notice is taken, hypothetically, to be signed and upgrade billing permitted.
